Outcome 4 requires a formal interview admission and corroborating verifiable auditable information connecting the suspect to the crime

Outcome 5 applies when the offender died before proceedings could be initiated

Outcome 6 records a lawfully issued Penalty Notice for Disorder or other relevant notifiable offence under the specified legislation

Outcome 7 records a cannabis or khat warning issued under College of Policing guidance

Outcome 8 records a Community Resolution with or without formal restorative justice

Outcome 9 applies when the Crown Prosecution Service decides prosecution or other formal action is not in the public interest

Outcome 10 applies when police decide formal action against the offender is not in the public interest

Outcome 11 applies where a named suspect is below the age of criminal responsibility

Outcome 12 applies where a named suspect is too physically or mentally ill to prosecute

Outcome 13 applies where a named suspect is identified but the victim or key witness is dead or too ill to give evidence

Outcome 14 applies where no named suspect is identified and the victim declines or cannot support further action to identify the offender

Outcome 15 applies where a named suspect is identified and the victim supports action but evidential difficulties prevent further action

Outcome 16 applies where a named suspect is identified but the victim does not support or withdraws support from police action

Outcome 17 applies where a suspect is identified but the prosecution time limit has expired

Outcome 18 applies where the crime has been investigated as far as reasonably possible and no suspect is identified

Outcome 20 applies when another body or agency will undertake further action and the victim is made aware

Outcome 21 applies where further investigation capable of supporting formal action is not in the public interest, by police decision
